description: KP Reader VI (Horary Astrology), worked horary example: number 29 given at Bombay at 5.30 P.M. IST on 6-5-1969, read in the archive.org OCR text (item kp-readers). Only values legible in the OCR are recorded. The Reader's cusps come from Raphael's printed Tables of Houses; its significator table includes node agency and conjunction/aspect significators, which Pandit Ji does not evaluate.

input.latitude_note: Bombay; the Reader does not print the coordinates used

known_deviations.intermediate_cusps: Pandit Ji solves the cusps with the true obliquity of the date; the Reader interpolates Raphael's tables. Cusp 12 differs by about 4 arcmin and cusp 8 by about 9 arcmin.
known_deviations.houses_2_and_5: Pandit Ji's 5th cusp falls at Leo 29 deg 33 min, 27 arcmin before Virgo, so the Sun is the 5th-house lord (level d); the Reader's list for house 5 omits the Sun and matches a 5th cusp in Virgo. For house 2, Venus (in Revati, a Mercury star; Mercury rules the 2nd cusp) is a level-c significator in Pandit Ji's result but is absent from the Reader's printed list; no reason is stated in the example. Every other house's Pandit Ji significators are a subset of the Reader's list, which also contains node-agency and conjunction/aspect significators.
